title: AIFS-TC: A simple correction competitive with the operational frontier for tropical cyclone intensity forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2608.09959v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: AI weather models are in the process of revolutionising weather forecasting. While these models have been shown to achieve superior performance to physics-based NWP in forecasting tropical cyclone (TC) tracks, they tend to dramatically underestimate intensity. Here we present AIFS-TC, a simple correction to the AIFS-Single model that is competitive with the operational state-of-the-art for forecasting maximum wind speed and minimum central pressure at lead times of 12 h to seven days. This performance also holds for rapid intensification events. Notably, the entire system was autonomously designed and built by a large language model (Claude Fable 5) in a few hours, directed through a small number of natural-language prompts by a single domain scientist. translated_title: AIFS-TC：一种与业务前沿竞争的热带气旋强度预测简单修正方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.09959v2 公告类型：替换交叉。摘要：AI天气模型正在彻底改变天气预报领域。尽管这些模型在预测热带气旋路径方面已显示出优于基于物理的数值天气预报的性能，但它们往往严重低估强度。在此，我们提出AIFS-TC，这是对AIFS-Single模型的一种简单修正，其在预测最大风速和最小中心气压方面，在12小时至7天的提前期内，与业务前沿技术具有竞争力。这一性能同样适用于快速增强事件。值得注意的是，整个系统是由一个大型语言模型（Claude Fable 5）在数小时内自主设计和构建的，由一位领域科学家通过少量自然语言提示进行指导。通过开源AI预测模型（AIFS-Single）和相对简单、廉价的后期处理达到业务前沿水平，这对热带气旋科学具有重要意义。
tldr: 本文提出AIFS-TC，一种简单修正方法，通过开源AI模型和轻量后处理达到业务前沿的热带气旋强度预测性能，并由大型语言模型自主构建。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces AIFS-TC, a simple correction achieving operational-frontier tropical cyclone intensity forecasting using an open-source AI model and lightweight post-processing, autonomously built by a large language model.
